name: fomalhaut647-plugins
description: Personal Claude Code plugins marketplace by Fomalhaut647

plugins.name: agent-team
plugins.description: Lead parallel sub-sessions in the Claude Code desktop app — agent-team:lead turns the current session into a lead that splits work across sub-sessions, verifies their results, runs one-shot code-review sessions, triages fixes, and merges every branch into one PR.

plugins.name: skill-simplifier
plugins.description: Audit a SKILL.md (with optional references/) or CLAUDE.md and remove upstream duplication and safeguards against imagined errors a fresh-session model would not make.

plugins.name: session-wrap
plugins.description: Wrap up a Claude Code desktop session — tidy docs with neat-freak, commit and push, open a PR, wait for CI (fixing failures), and merge it into main, close the issues the session fixed, clean up stale branches and worktrees, then archive the session; optionally gate the merge with code-review sub-sessions. Activates only when the user's message contains the exact word session-wrap (hyphenation and case don't matter).

plugins.name: neat-freak
plugins.description: End-of-session knowledge cleanup: reconcile project docs, rule files (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md), agent memory, and workspace residue with what the code actually does, and audit whether workspace rules are followed. Packaged from 数字生命卡兹克's khazix-skills (MIT).

plugins.name: kill-guard
plugins.description: Block Bash commands that find processes by name or command-line text and kill them (pkill, killall, xargs kill, kill $(pgrep …)), and tell Claude to stop processes by PID instead.
